SAMPLE RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT
FICTIONAL DOCUMENT FOR DEMONSTRATION ONLY. All names, places and figures are
invented.
This Lease is made between Acme Property Holdings Ltd (the Landlord) and Jane Example (the
Tenant) for the premises at Flat 4B, 12 Imaginary Road, Sampletown.

1. Term
The lease begins on 1 January 2027 and ends on 31 December 2027.

2. Rent
The Tenant shall pay rent of 1,200 per month, due on the 1st day of each month.

2.1 Late Payment
Rent paid after the 5th day of the month incurs a late fee of 50 per day.

2.2 Rent Increase
The Landlord may increase the rent at any time by giving the Tenant 14 days notice.

3. Security Deposit
The Tenant shall pay a security deposit equal to three months rent.

3.1 Forfeiture
The Tenant shall forfeit the entire security deposit if the Tenant ends this lease for any reason
before the end of the term, regardless of the condition of the premises.

4. Automatic Renewal
This lease shall automatically renew for a further twelve months unless the Tenant gives written
notice of non-renewal at least 90 days before the end of the term.

5. Early Termination
If the Tenant ends this lease early, the Tenant shall pay an early termination fee equal to all
remaining rent for the full term, in addition to any forfeiture under clause 3.1.

6. Repairs and Liability
The Tenant is responsible for all repairs to the premises, including structural repairs. The Tenant
shall indemnify the Landlord against all claims, including those caused by the Landlord's own
negligence.

7. Notices
All notices must be in writing and delivered by registered post.

8. Changes to Terms
The Landlord may amend any term of this lease by notifying the Tenant. Continued occupation
constitutes acceptance of the amended terms.

9. Governing Law
This lease is governed by the laws of Sampletown.

SAMPLE CONTRACT OF EMPLOYMENT
FICTIONAL DOCUMENT FOR DEMONSTRATION ONLY. All names, places and figures are
invented.
This Contract is made between Example Traders Ltd of P.O. Box 00000, Nairobi (the Employer)
and Jane Example, ID No. 00000000 (the Employee).

1. Position and Start Date
The Employee is employed as an Accounts Assistant starting on 1 February 2027.

2. Probation
The first twelve months of employment are a probationary period, which the Employer may extend
at its sole discretion. During probation either party may end this contract without notice.

3. Salary
The Employee shall be paid a gross salary of KES 60,000 per month, payable in arrears.

3.1 Deductions
The Employer may deduct from the Employee's salary any amount the Employer considers owed
by the Employee, including the cost of any lost or damaged company property.

4. Working Hours
Normal working hours are 8am to 5pm, Monday to Saturday. The Employee shall work such
additional hours as the business requires, and the salary covers all hours worked.

5. Annual Leave
The Employee is entitled to 14 working days of paid annual leave per year.

6. Place of Work
The Employee's place of work is Nairobi. The Employer may transfer the Employee to any branch
in Kenya at any time, and the Employee shall bear the cost of relocating.

7. Termination
After probation, either party may end this contract by giving 7 days written notice. The Employer
may dismiss the Employee summarily for any reason it considers sufficient, without a hearing.

8. Confidentiality and Non-Competition
For three years after this contract ends, the Employee shall not work for or start any business in
Kenya that competes with the Employer.

9. Intellectual Property
Everything the Employee creates, whether during working hours or not, belongs to the Employer.

10. Changes to this Contract
The Employer may change any term of this contract by posting a notice at the workplace.

11. Governing Law
This contract is governed by the laws of Kenya.
